result.reason: The addition reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable export within 30 days, and written certification of deletion. However, it goes beyond the playbook by applying return and deletion duties to all Works, Confidential Information, and Company materials—not just Customer Data—and could sweep materials relating to other Statements of Work when only one SOW terminates. “Thereafter” also leaves the deletion and certification deadline indefinite. The operative language should be narrowed to Customer Data associated with the terminated arrangement and should specify the deletion/certification timing.
